title: Transferring funds to another bank
summary: Explains how to transfer funds to another bank: initiate an external transfer from the transfers menu and select the destination account; external transfers generally complete in 2 business days. Also covers EveryonePay to recipients at other banks with a $2,000 daily limit and tips to verify account details and stay within limits.
